name: Polanian Dieselworks
backstory: Riveted walkers keep the dieselworks earning while the owners expand its facilities. The eventual trio covers practical fire, heavy contact and long-range support.
strategy_personality: Dieselpunk machinery fills a material and era gap: rivets, exhausts, painted steel, and agricultural-industrial construction. Facility-led spending suits the setting's production economy. Final chassis selection still needs a focused roster pass.
